name: Star Fox 64 Recompiled
description:
Star Fox 64 Recompiled is a native PC port of the classic 1997 Nintendo 64 space rail-shooter Star Fox 64 (Lylat Wars). Using static recompilation, Fox McCloud's Arwing battles run natively on modern PC hardware.

Features:
- Native execution delivering smooth 60 FPS space combat without emulation slowdown
- True widescreen and high-resolution rendering with dynamic visual clarity
- Dual-analog gamepad and flight stick support with modern rumble feedback
- Preserves complete branching mission routes, iconic voice acting, and soundtrack
- Support for community visual mods and audio enhancements
